summary: Under normal circumstances, the fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets, plus borrowings for investment purposes, in (a) the U.S. Equity strategy and (b) the Gold/Bitcoin strategy. The fund manager will target a 100% exposure to each of its U.S. Equity strategy and its Gold/Bitcoin strategy. The fund is non-diversified.
